study type: Qualitative study using semi-structured interviews and thematic analysis
exposure: Implementation of Public Health England (PHE) infection prevention and control guidance
outcome: Successes and barriers to guidance implementation
cohort: The participants were obstetricians, midwives and neonatologists who worked in a maternity unit in England, UK.
finding: Successes in implementing PHE guidance were linked to existing infrastructure, training satisfaction, and organizational culture, while barriers included applicability issues, undesirable guidance timings and frequency, staff compliance reductions, physical unit layout, IT compatibility, PPE availability, and varied testing arrangements.
cross-section timing: Interviews conducted between March 2020 and July 2021, reflecting on the COVID-19 pandemic period.
